examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{長年|ながねん}の{修行|しゅぎょう}を{経|へ}て{悟|さと}りに{至|いた}った。
examples.english: He reached enlightenment after many years of training.

examples.japanese: {禅|ぜん}の{世界|せかい}では、{悟|さと}りは{突然|とつぜん}やってくるものとされる。
examples.english: In the world of Zen, enlightenment is said to come suddenly.

notes:
{悟|さと}り is the noun form of the verb {悟|さと}る (to realize, to understand). In Buddhist contexts, it refers to spiritual awakening or enlightenment.

Key expressions:
- {悟|さと}りを{開|ひら}く (to attain enlightenment)
- {悟|さと}りに{至|いた}る (to reach enlightenment)
- {悟|さと}りの{境地|きょうち} (state of enlightenment)

In everyday usage, {悟|さと}り can also refer to a profound realization or acceptance of truth about life.
